title: GrowerHub news — new features and updates
heading: GrowerHub news
description: New app features, useful guides and fixes. See what changed and how to try it.

entries.text: The watering plan refreshes after settings are saved. The previous plan is no longer shown as current while the new one loads.
Watering device cards direct you to a bounded session through the greenhouse. The off button remains available.
A new page opens at the top when you follow a menu or article link. Back navigation and section links retain their usual behaviour.
The watering log guide now explains measured, estimated and unknown water volumes.
